data.title: 五和 · 晨光榻榻米被褥里的甜美依恋
data.description: 晨光洒满榻榻米被单，散发着初夜后温存的余香。五和整个人像小猫一样贴在你的怀中，小脸枕在你的臂弯里，双手紧紧搂着你的腰身，带着极致幸福的微笑安宁小憩。
data.action: nestled deeply under white futon sheets with bare shoulders exposed, hugging partner waist tight with a blissful wife smile in morning light
data.lighting: golden morning sunlight streaming across white sheets and tatami
data.mood: morning newlywed tranquility, sweet unconditional love, eternal matrimonial peace
